title: L3Harris and Partners Demonstrate Multi-Domain Capabilities at EVEREST: Pacific Vigilance
summary: L3Harris Technologies and industry partners demonstrated military and civil mission scenarios confronting Asia-Pacific nations during an exercise in Taiwan.
body_markdown:
**MELBOURNE, Fla., Nov. 17, 2026** — L3Harris Technologies and industry partners demonstrated military and civil mission scenarios confronting Asia-Pacific nations during an exercise in Taiwan.


The recent EVEREST™: Pacific Vigilance event showcased interoperable technologies, enhanced with AI, that accelerate the planning and decision-making cycle and link sensors to shooters. The event presented persistent sensing, early-warning detection, strategic and operational fires coordination, whole-of-society defense concepts and civil-military hybrid resilience.


“Pacific Vigilance demonstrated the technical capabilities, innovation and partnerships we have today to deliver ready, reliable and scalable solutions for current operational needs and emerging security concepts,” said Kevin Steubing, Vice President, International Business Development, Communications & Spectrum Dominance, L3Harris. “This has been our third EVEREST event in the past four years, and each time, we are bringing in more integrated technology and partners to provide enhanced benefit to our customers around the world.”


Several dozen global companies and local small businesses participated in this year’s EVEREST event. Previous events were held in[the United Kingdom in 2023](https://www.l3harris.com/newsroom/editorial/2023/06/defining-future-military-connectivity-everest-uk) and in[the Netherlands in 2025.](https://www.l3harris.com/newsroom/editorial/2025/06/reaching-new-heights-communication-network-modernization)
